# Data report (generated by src/kairos_repro/data/stats.py)

## The first four questions

**1. How big is it, and what are the columns?**  
89770902 edge rows in 600 graphs; 6 columns: source-id, source-type, dest-id, dest-type, edge-type, graph-id. Expected: 89770902 rows, 600 graphs.

**2. What type is each column?**  
ids are opaque strings (kept as text), the three type columns are single-letter codes. Observed node-type codes: a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h. Observed edge-type codes: 26 of the 26 expected.

**3. What is missing or malformed?**  
0 malformed lines skipped; 0 unknown node-type codes; 0 unknown edge-type codes.

**4. What does the thing we predict look like?**  
Label = 1 for graphs 300-399 (drive-by-download), else 0. All data: 500 benign / 100 attack graphs. Test split: 375 benign / 100 attack, so attack share is 21.1%; guessing benign every time scores 0.789 accuracy (the do-nothing baseline, `make baselines`).
